instruction.name: vmod.d
instruction.description: Compute the remainder of each signed 64-bit element in `a` divided by the corresponding element in `b`.

throughput.notes: Range over the same pairs: min CPI 3.00 at 0/1, max CPI 12.50 at 9223372036854775807/1. Sample uses 1/1.

notes: LSX variable-latency integer divide/modulo. Latency uses an element-0 reset helper; throughput uses 8 independent lanes. Ranges cover positive operands including powers of two and max values. Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
